sentences: Insulin is used for children with type 2 diabetes who have a blood glucose of more than 250 mg per dl and a HbA1C greater than 8.5%.

A health care team for managing pediatric diabetes may include a pediatric endocrinologist or physician trained in pediatric diabetes, a diabetes specialist nurse, a registered dietitian, a psychologist, a social worker, and child life specialist.
Diagnostic criteria for type 2 diabetes in children include plasma blood glucose of more than 200 mg per deciliter (dl) or a fasting blood glucose above 126 mg per dl in children with overt symptoms.
Differentiating type 1 diabetes from type 2 diabetes may include assessment of fasting blood insulin or C-peptide, or determination of autoantibodies for type 1 diabetes.
Early recognition, screening, treatment, and education of children with diabetes are needed to prevent long-term disease complications.
Adoption of healthy lifestyle practices and metformin medication are recommended as initial treatments for type 2 diabetes in children.
Metformin at 500 mg per day is used upon diagnosis of type 2 diabetes in children.

The goal of the health care team (which may include a pediatric endocrinologist or physician trained in pediatric diabetes, a diabetes specialist nurse, a registered dietitian, a psychologist, a social worker, and child life specialist) and the diabetic child's family is to empower the child to make informed decisions for health‐promoting lifestyle choices.
Diabetes management for children requires the integration of the family and health care team to be committed and continuous for promotion of self-management in pediatric diabetes patients.
Screening for type 2 diabetes typically starts at 10 years old for obese children and those who have at least two risk factors for developing type 2 diabetes.
all_qs_and_as: What are the recommended initial treatments for type 2 diabetes in children?
The recommended initial treatments for type 2 diabetes in children are adoption of healthy lifestyle practices and metformin medication.
What are the diagnostic criteria for type 2 diabetes in children?

The diagnostic criteria for type 2 diabetes in children include plasma blood glucose of more than 200 mg per deciliter or a fasting blood glucose above 126 mg per deciliter in children with overt symptoms.
At what age does screening for type 2 diabetes typically begin in children?
Screening for type 2 diabetes typically starts at 10 years old for obese children and those who have at least two risk factors for developing type 2 diabetes.
Why is early recognition and screening important for children with diabetes?
Early recognition and screening are important to prevent long-term disease complications in children with diabetes.
What tests can help differentiate between type 1 and type 2 diabetes in children?
Tests that can help differentiate between type 1 and type 2 diabetes in children include assessment of fasting blood insulin or C-peptide, or determination of autoantibodies for type 1 diabetes.
What is the role of the family in managing diabetes for children with type 2 diabetes?

The family must be committed and continuous in their integration with the health care team to promote self-management in pediatric diabetes patients, and work together with the health care team to empower the child to make informed decisions for health-promoting lifestyle choices.
What are the criteria for using insulin in children with type 2 diabetes?
Insulin is used for children with type 2 diabetes who have a blood glucose of more than 250 mg per dl and a HbA1C greater than 8.5%.

result.theory:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :finite-model-find true)
(set-option :fmf-bound true)
;; Sorts
(declare-sort Person 0)
(declare-sort Disease 0)
(declare-sort Intervention 0)
(declare-sort Medication 0)
(declare-sort Measurement 0)
(declare-sort Age 0)
(declare-sort Role 0)
(declare-sort Team 0)
(declare-sort Family 0)
;; Person predicates
(declare-fun is-child (Person) Bool)
(declare-fun is-obese (Person) Bool)
(declare-fun age-of (Person) Age)
(declare-fun age-at-least (Age Int) Bool)
(declare-fun adopts-healthy-lifestyle (Person) Bool)
(declare-fun has-blood-glucose (Person Int) Bool)
(declare-fun has-hba1c (Person Real) Bool)
;; Disease predicates
(declare-fun has-disease (Person Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun diagnosed-with (Person Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun has-overt-symptoms (Person Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun has-risk-factor (Person Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun is-diabetes (Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun is-type1-diabetes (Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun is-type2-diabetes (Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun is-complication-of (Disease Disease) Bool)
;; Intervention predicates
(declare-fun is-recognition (Intervention) Bool)
(declare-fun is-screening (Intervention) Bool)
(declare-fun is-treatment (Intervention) Bool)
(declare-fun is-education (Intervention) Bool)
(declare-fun prevents (Intervention Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun is-needed-for (Intervention Person Disease) Bool)
;; Measurement predicates
(declare-fun is-plasma-glucose (Measurement) Bool)
(declare-fun is-fasting-glucose (Measurement) Bool)
(declare-fun is-fasting-insulin (Measurement) Bool)
(declare-fun is-c-peptide (Measurement) Bool)
(declare-fun is-autoantibody (Measurement) Bool)
(declare-fun measurement-value (Measurement) Int)
(declare-fun is-diagnostic-for (Measurement Disease) Bool)
;; Medication predicates
(declare-fun is-metformin (Medication) Bool)
(declare-fun is-insulin (Medication) Bool)
(declare-fun is-medication-for (Medication Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun is-recommended-treatment (Medication Person Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun uses-medication (Person Medication) Bool)
(declare-fun has-dosage (Medication Int) Bool)
(declare-fun is-recommended-for (Person Disease) Bool)
;; Team and Family predicates
(declare-fun member-of (Person Team) Bool)
(declare-fun has-role (Person Role) Bool)
(declare-fun family-of (Family Person) Bool)
(declare-fun is-committed (Team) Bool)
(declare-fun is-committed-family (Family) Bool)
(declare-fun is-continuous (Team) Bool)
(declare-fun promotes-self-management (Team Person) Bool)
(declare-fun is-healthcare-team-for (Team Disease) Bool)
(declare-fun empowers-for-informed-decisions (Team Person) Bool)
(declare-fun empowers-for-informed-decisions-family (Family Person) Bool)
;; Disease constants
(declare-const diabetes Disease)
(declare-const type1-diabetes Disease)
(declare-const type2-diabetes Disease)
(declare-const long-term-complication Disease)
;; Medication constants
(declare-const metformin Medication)
(declare-const insulin Medication)
;; Role constants
(declare-const pediatric-endocrinologist Role)
(declare-const physician-trained-in-pediatric-diabetes Role)
(declare-const diabetes-specialist-nurse Role)
(declare-const registered-dietitian Role)
(declare-const psychologist Role)
(declare-const social-worker Role)
(declare-const child-life-specialist Role)
;; Team member constants
(declare-const team-member-1 Person)
(declare-const team-member-2 Person)
(declare-const team-member-3 Person)
(declare-const team-member-4 Person)
(declare-const team-member-5 Person)
(declare-const team-member-6 Person)
;; Example instances
(declare-const example-team Team)
(declare-const example-family Family)
(declare-const example-child Person)
;; Disease type assertions
(assert (is-diabetes diabetes))
(assert (and (is-diabetes type1-diabetes) (is-type1-diabetes type1-diabetes)))
(assert (and (is-diabetes type2-diabetes) (is-type2-diabetes type2-diabetes)))
(assert (is-complication-of long-term-complication diabetes))
;; Medication type assertions
(assert (is-metformin metformin))
(assert (is-insulin insulin))
;; Prevention of complications through interventions
(assert (forall ((p Person) (i Intervention))
  (=> (and (is-child p) 
           (has-disease p diabetes)
           (or (is-recognition i) (is-screening i) (is-treatment i) (is-education i))
           (is-needed-for i p diabetes))
      (prevents i long-term-complication))))
;; Screening requirements for at-risk children
(assert (forall ((p Person) (i Intervention))
  (=> (and (is-child p)
           (age-at-least (age-of p) 10)
           (or (is-obese p)
               (has-risk-factor p type2-diabetes))
           (is-screening i))
      (is-needed-for i p type2-diabetes))))
;; Diagnostic criteria - plasma glucose
(assert (forall ((p Person) (m Measurement))
  (=> (and (is-child p)
           (is-plasma-glucose m)
           (> (measurement-value m) 200)
           (has-overt-symptoms p type2-diabetes))
      (is-diagnostic-for m type2-diabetes))))
;; Diagnostic criteria - fasting glucose
(assert (forall ((p Person) (m Measurement))
  (=> (and (is-child p)
           (is-fasting-glucose m)
           (> (measurement-value m) 126)
           (has-overt-symptoms p type2-diabetes))
      (is-diagnostic-for m type2-diabetes))))
;; Diagnostic criteria for type 1 diabetes
(assert (forall ((m Measurement))
  (=> (or (is-fasting-insulin m) (is-c-peptide m))
      (is-diagnostic-for m type1-diabetes))))
(assert (forall ((m Measurement))
  (=> (is-autoantibody m)
      (is-diagnostic-for m type1-diabetes))))
;; Treatment recommendations - metformin
(assert (forall ((p Person))
  (=> (and (is-child p)
           (has-disease p type2-diabetes)
           (or (diagnosed-with p type2-diabetes) (has-disease p type2-diabetes)))
      (is-recommended-treatment metformin p type2-diabetes))))
;; Lifestyle recommendations
(assert (forall ((p Person))
  (=> (and (is-child p)
           (has-disease p type2-diabetes)
           (adopts-healthy-lifestyle p))
      (is-recommended-for p type2-diabetes))))
;; Metformin initial dosage for diagnosed children
(assert (=> (and (is-child example-child) 
                 (diagnosed-with example-child type2-diabetes))
            (and (uses-medication example-child metformin) 
                 (has-dosage metformin 500))))
;; Insulin for children with high glucose and HbA1c
(assert (=> (and (is-child example-child) 
                 (has-disease example-child type2-diabetes)
                 (has-blood-glucose example-child 260)
                 (has-hba1c example-child 9.0))
            (uses-medication example-child insulin)))
;; Team-based care promotes self-management
(assert (=> (and (is-child example-child) 
                 (has-disease example-child type2-diabetes)
                 (is-healthcare-team-for example-team type2-diabetes)
                 (family-of example-family example-child)
                 (is-committed example-team)
                 (is-committed-family example-family)
                 (is-continuous example-team))
            (promotes-self-management example-team example-child)))
;; Healthcare team structure
(assert (is-healthcare-team-for example-team type2-diabetes))
(assert (member-of team-member-1 example-team))
(assert (or (has-role team-member-1 pediatric-endocrinologist)
            (has-role team-member-1 physician-trained-in-pediatric-diabetes)))
(assert (member-of team-member-2 example-team))
(assert (has-role team-member-2 diabetes-specialist-nurse))
(assert (member-of team-member-3 example-team))
(assert (has-role team-member-3 registered-dietitian))
(assert (member-of team-member-4 example-team))
(assert (has-role team-member-4 psychologist))
(assert (member-of team-member-5 example-team))
(assert (has-role team-member-5 social-worker))
(assert (member-of team-member-6 example-team))
(assert (has-role team-member-6 child-life-specialist))
;; Team and family empowerment
(assert (=> (and (is-child example-child)
                 (has-disease example-child type2-diabetes)
                 (is-healthcare-team-for example-team type2-diabetes)
                 (family-of example-family example-child))
            (and (empowers-for-informed-decisions example-team example-child)
                 (empowers-for-informed-decisions-family example-family example-child))))
(check-sat)
